reason: Terminated by express revocation. EO 5700 provides that Executive Order No. 9 of January 17, 1873 'is hereby amended so as to permit' the officeholding it describes. Executive Order 11408 (President Lyndon B. Johnson, signed April 25, 1968, filed April 25 and published April 27, 1968, 33 FR 6459) provides in section 2 that prior Executive orders insofar as they amend Executive Order No. 9 'are hereby revoked' and lists '5700, August 31, 1931'. It states no later effective date, so it took effect on signing, 1968-04-25. Actor: President Johnson through EO 11408.
